en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, AWS Lambda, SQS, Redis, CloudWatch, Jest, Jenkins
en.title: Store orders processed in queues
en.summary: Saldofone sells devices as scrap through a store on Nuvemshop. I built the backend that receives the store's orders and processes them on AWS.
en.context: Saldofone's store runs on Nuvemshop, and each order placed there had to reach the backend and be processed.
en.role: I built the NestJS backend, the Next.js frontend and the AWS services.
en.built: The orders arrive from Nuvemshop through a webhook, and Lambda microservices and worker Lambdas process them through SQS queues, with Redis. The Next.js frontend is hosted serverless, the logs are read in CloudWatch, Jest runs the end-to-end tests and Jenkins the CI/CD.
en.learned: My first project on AWS: serverless hosting, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch and Redis.
